lines.zh: 肉质的鳍一摆，我缓缓前移。
lines.en: My fleshy fins stroke and I ease forward.

lines.zh: 我贴着水底滑，几乎不扬泥。
lines.en: I skim the bottom, barely stirring silt.

lines.zh: 尾一收一放，我推开水流。
lines.en: My tail gathers and releases, pushing water aside.

lines.zh: 我用胸鳍支着，走得像爬。
lines.en: I prop on my pectoral fins and creep along.

lines.zh: 水里很安静，只有我的鳍在响。
lines.en: The water's quiet but for my fins.
I go around a sunken log, slowly.

lines.zh: 身体一节一节地扭，我往前。
lines.en: My body undulates in sections as I go.

lines.zh: 我浮到中水层，看得远些。
lines.en: I rise to midwater for a longer view.

lines.zh: 光线从上面打下来，我眯了眼。
lines.en: Light comes down and I squint.
My gill covers keep working.
I slide down the slope into deeper water.

lines.zh: 底沙很软，我的鳍印很清楚。
lines.en: The sand's soft, so my fin prints show.
I ride the current and spend no effort.

lines.zh: 我游过一丛水草，没碰它。
lines.en: I pass a clump of weeds without touching it.

lines.zh: 转身要费力，我尽量走直线。
lines.en: Turning costs me; I keep to straight lines.

lines.zh: 我的鳞在暗处泛着钝光。
lines.en: My scales show a dull sheen in the dark.
I hold still with my fins fanning slowly.
My gills open and close in rhythm.

lines.zh: 我悬着，比停在石头上还稳。
lines.en: I hover, steadier than on a rock.

lines.zh: 底下的沙里有东西在动。
lines.en: Something's moving in the sand below.
I'm reading the taste of the water.
My fins hang nearly motionless.

lines.zh: 小鱼从嘴边过，我懒得动。
lines.en: A minnow passes my mouth; I don't bother.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛很大，看得很清。
lines.en: My eyes are large and see clearly.
The current bends around me.
I settle half an inch.

lines.zh: 我把身体侧过来，光变亮了。
lines.en: I turn side-on and the light brightens.
Nobody's come to this water in a long while.
My tail tip brushes the sand.
I'm waiting for the surface to dim.

lines.zh: 水底的光一层层淡下去。
lines.en: The light on the bottom fades layer by layer.
I lay my pectoral fins on the sand.
Your shadow reaches the bottom.
I aim my broad head at the bank.

lines.zh: 你在干处，我在水下看你。
lines.en: You're on dry ground; I watch from below.
Your shape wavers through the water.
I fan my fins slowly and don't flee.
There is no net in your hands.

lines.zh: 我偏过宽头，用单眼盯你。
lines.en: I tilt my broad head and watch with one eye.
Light dances on the surface.

lines.zh: 我浮上来一些，离你更近。
lines.en: I rise a little closer to you.

lines.zh: 你的手伸进水里会很凉。
lines.en: Your hand would be cold in this water.
My gill cover shuts once.
Across the water, neither moves first.

lines.zh: 我猛地一摆尾，退了很远。
lines.en: One hard tail stroke and I'm far back.
The blood taste thickens at once.

lines.zh: 我的胸鳍撕开，游起来发沉。
lines.en: A pectoral fin tears; swimming feels heavy.
That struck my flank.

lines.zh: 我钻进石缝，腮还在急动。
lines.en: I wedge into a crevice, gills racing.

lines.zh: 我的鳞翻起，露出底下的肉。
lines.en: Scales lift, baring flesh beneath.

lines.zh: 我喘不上水，腮动得更快。
lines.en: I can't draw water; my gills work faster.

lines.zh: 我伤在侧腹，尾巴还能摆。
lines.en: The wound is in my flank; my tail still works.

lines.zh: 血味混进水里，我记住了。
lines.en: Blood mixes with water; I remember.
I press flat to the bottom.
A splash; I head for the rings.
The scent spreads; I head for it.
I draw in water and taste it.

lines.zh: 我连牙缝都塞不满，可我要。
lines.en: Not enough to fill my teeth, but I want it.

lines.zh: 我先绕半圈，看看有没有钩。
lines.en: Half a circle first, checking for a hook.
I have bitten this scent before.
Don't put your hand in; I'll bite.
I approach slowly, carefully.

lines.zh: 我闻到这味道从岸边渗进来。
lines.en: I smell it seeping in from the bank.
I glance back at the bank.
I come closer, then draw back.

lines.zh: 这味道在水里散得很慢。
lines.en: The taste spreads slowly through the water.
Mouth open, I wait for it to sink.
Stand there and don't move.
My fins are quivering.
I circle it slowly.

lines.zh: 你撞在水里，波推开了我。
lines.en: You hit the water and the wave pushes me off.
Your shove knocked me sideways.
I angle a fin and steady myself.
Underwater collisions are muffled.

lines.zh: 我从你腿边擦过，鳞很滑。
lines.en: I brush past your leg, scales slick.
My scales are slipperier than they look.
I withdrew into deeper water.
The weeds sway wildly where we hit.
Don't step on my tail.

lines.zh: 这一点水，容不下我们两个。
lines.en: This little water can't hold both of us.

lines.zh: 另一条影子从深处上来。
lines.en: Another shadow rises from below.

lines.zh: 我们并排悬着，鳍几乎碰到。
lines.en: We hover side by side, fins almost touching.
I circle once, slowly.

lines.zh: 它的鳞和我的颜色很近。
lines.en: Its scales are close to my colour.

lines.zh: 水流在我们之间变得很缓。
lines.en: The current slows between us.
We sink to the bottom together.
My fin tip brushes its scales.

lines.zh: 这条水沟，只有我们两条。
lines.en: Only the two of us in this channel.
We hold still side by side a long while.
Then it swam away first.
I take the thing and don't swallow.
I sweep it to my mouth with a fin.
A bright stone on the bottom.
Too small; it slipped from my mouth.

lines.zh: 我含了一会儿又吐出来。
lines.en: I hold it a while and spit it out.
There's meat inside this shell.
I nose the sand aside.
It rolled into a crevice.
It grits my teeth; I spit it out.
I balance it on a fin.
Something moved in the water.

lines.zh: 我的鳍先转，身体才跟上。
lines.en: My fins turn first; the body follows.
My fins have spread.
I sink low against the bottom.
Its back is to me; perfect chance.
I'm fixed on its flank.

lines.zh: 水纹一动，我知道它转向了。
lines.en: A ripple tells me it has turned.

lines.zh: 它只顾水面的光，没看我。
lines.en: It watches the surface light, not me.
I edge closer.
If it moves, I'll be quicker.
I follow its shadow.
It goes left; I keep to the bottom.
I've nearly stopped finning.
The surface light happens to hide me.

lines.zh: 它悬住，我就贴着底不动。
lines.en: It hovers; I hold against the bottom.
I open my mouth barely.
The gap closes bit by bit.
It turned side-on — there's my chance.
The sand ripples cover my shape.
Another half foot closer.

lines.zh: 我一口咬下去，牙齿很细。
lines.en: I bite; my teeth are fine.
A sharp twist and I ram it.
My tail sweeps its legs.
Teeth close; I shake my head and tear.

lines.zh: 我整条身子一拧，撞进去。
lines.en: My whole body twists into the strike.
It tore free, trailing blood.
My second bite goes for the gills.

lines.zh: 血雾散开，我追着味道咬。
lines.en: Blood clouds spread; I bite toward the scent.
It's sinking.
I back off, finning slowly.
I rise from the dark into the shallows.

lines.zh: 第一口气是水，不是空气。
lines.en: My first breath is water, not air.
My fins spread out in the water.
It's dark, and the water's cold.
I press to the bottom sand and stay still.

lines.zh: 光从上面一点点透下来。
lines.en: Light seeps down from above.
Something's moving on the surface.
I sweep my tail once.
Weeds stand between me and the open.
My gill cover opens and I begin to breathe.

lines.zh: 水在烧，我的鳍缩了起来。
lines.en: The water burns and my fins curl.
Out of water, I flop against the stone.
Water has clogged my gills.
The blast goes off and flips me over.

lines.zh: 一根尖东西穿了我的鳍。
lines.en: Something sharp went through my fin.

lines.zh: 有东西在我身体里打转。
lines.en: Something is turning inside my body.

lines.zh: 水里没吃的了，我越来越轻。
lines.en: Nothing left to eat; I'm getting lighter.

lines.zh: 雷进了水，我整条都僵了。
lines.en: Lightning enters the water and stiffens me.
The water's gone and I drop.
